verdict.rationale: Claude is itself the AI layer, and its first-party code execution tool runs Python in a sandboxed container "to analyze data". Pre-built Skills handle Excel and PDF documents, and the consumer app can run code and create files. Together these deliver the core of turning user data into AI-generated analysis inside the product. missing for 10: explicit documentation of insight or suggestion generation as a named feature (beyond general data analysis), and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Run Python and bash code in a sandboxed container to analyze data, generate files, and iterate on solutions.
Anthropic provides pre-built Agent Skills for common document tasks (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, PDF), and you can create your own custom Skills.
